data.one_liner: Quran text, translations, audio URLs, and metadata for Flutter apps
data.what_it_does: Provides Quran text in Arabic, translations in multiple languages, audio streaming URLs, and lookup details for pages, juz, surah, ayah, and place of revelation. Also includes search functionality and helper constants.
use_when: Building an Islamic or Quranic application in Flutter
Displaying Quranic text, translations, or metadata like Juz and Surah details
Fetching audio recitation URLs for verses and surahs
avoid_when: You need complete offline audio file management or downloading features rather than just URLs
You require complex Quran page layout rendering engines beyond standard text/font display
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of Quran text, metadata, and multiple language translations
Built-in audio URL helpers supporting various reciters and bitrates
weaknesses: Does not handle audio playback directly, only provides URLs
Relies on external packages like google_fonts for proper text display rendering
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml and optionally configure google_fonts for proper rendering of Arabic text.
